top_items.title: Somehow, Jensen Huang Returned
top_items.summary: Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as president and CEO of Nvidia, while he'll also return to the Board of Directors. This is happening just hours after US President Donald Trump said Huang should come back . "The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia," the technology giant said. "In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk." Nvidia chair of the Board Harvey C. Jones said the Board believes "Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers." "We have every confidence in Jensen and look forward to working with him as he resumes his leadership of the Company. We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as Nvidia's Chief Financial Officer," he added. Trump said in a social media post that Nvidia's Board made "the correct and proper decision" to bring Huang back. Trump went on to say that the US government has no real to believe that Huang's return "poses any risk to national security." https://twitter.com/TheStalwart/status/2124868325524054057 For his part, Huang said he is honored to return to Nvidia to lead what he called "one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution." "I am also deeply thankful to our employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support. Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work.” Huang was ousted from Nvidia earlier this month after it came to light that he had a romantic relationship with a person that sources said was possibly a spy for China, though no hard evidence was ever provided to back this up. It was later reported that Huang had multiple other affairs with people he worked with. In response to the reports, Nvidia formed a committee made up of independent directors who had the job of investigating the "foreign intelligence" claims. Additionally, the committee hired an independent attorney to assist, and that investigation remains ongoing, with Huang's support. In addition to the internal investigation, there are multiple other open cases against Nvidia, including a probe by the SEC over financial accounting claims. In response to the entire situation, Nvidia has also created a new National Security and Export Control Committee to "oversee trade complicance and national security risks." Prior to today, Nvidia's board said it had no intention of bringing Huang back, but things can change fast. For his part, Huang said he would be "honored" to return as Nvidia's CEO. The Nvidia controversies led to turmoil in the stock market, in part because Nvidia is one of the “Mag 7” companies that are driving growth in the US. Some of the information coming to light suggests that Nvidia’s accounting and export control compliance are not buttoned up, and this has fueled further concerns about the growth potential and returns on investment for the AI trade. Numerous other technology and AI stocks have dropped in value significantly since the Nvidia news broke. Now that Huang is back as CEO, though, not only is Nvidia's stock price ripping, but the market overall--not just AI and tech stocks--is seeing positive upwards trends.

top_items.title: Cyberpunk 2 Is Canceled, Director Jokes, After GTA 6 Raises The Bar
top_items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has raised the bar for open-world games, and Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzyński is feeling it. Online, the developer jokingly commented about GTA 6 setting a new gold standard for the genre, a level of quality that makes him want to pack up his Cyberpunk 2 development bags and call it a day. "GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real," Sarzyński wrote online. Probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, I mean it. Scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle. Cyberpunk 2 is canceled, Imma go sweep autumn leaves in my backyard now." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OAN_BXmVR0g Don't worry, Cyberpunk fans, because Sarzyński believes the game will offer a unique "flavor" compared to GTA 6. "Seriously though, I think we're doing something of our own, with a different, unique flavor," he wrote in a follow-up post. "GTA is impressive in a way all great art is; it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed." Meanwhile, Cyberpunk 2077 has had a great 2026, as the release of the new Cyberpunk Edgerunners anime series once again drove the game's numbers up . A meaty update also helped draw new players, and Cyberpunk 2 game director Gabe Amatangelo recently shared more thoughts on how the sequel is evolving beyond his original vision as more people join the project. Other developers across the industry have also commented on GTA 6, and Naughty Dog world design director Michael Barclay also believes that it is a technological achievement. "I've made video games for 19 years, and GTA6 appears to me as a Bugatti Veyron would to a nervous Victorian child," he wrote. Payday 2 game director David Goldfarb has been utterly astonished by what he has seen so far, while The Last of Us: Part 2 and Star Wars: Jedi - Survivor character artist Del Walker wrote that he can't believe what he's seeing (and how some black magic might be involved): https://twitter.com/locust9/status/2123203448057536751 https://twitter.com/TheCartelDel/status/2123632078457831663 GTA 6 has had a phenomenal start , selling 44.9 million copies in its first weekend and making $4 billion. The first post-launch patch has also gone live, though we're not too sure what it does yet. top_items.title: GTA 6: Don’t Finish Chapter 2 Before Doing These Things
top_items.summary: GTA 6 's first chapter is a lengthy prologue that gets you up to speed on the gameplay, the characters, and the storyline. But once you've cleared the final mission and you start Chapter 2, that's when the game really begins. This is where the protagonists Jason and Lucia cement their decision to go full Bonnie and Clyde, and since this chapter unfolds at a faster pace, you'll want to keep an eye out for a few missable items , people, and missions before you hit the point of no return that leads directly into Chapter 3. Which mission ends Chapter 2 in GTA 6? Appropriately, Chapter 2 in GTA 6 ends with the mission Checking Out after you reach the Move to Vice City point on your map, as Jason and Lucia will leave their current residence behind as they embark on a new journey to Vice City. To get there, you'll need to complete the following missions: What's in the Bag? Ambulance Chaser Just Moved In Girls' Trip Moses Daily Driver Slam Dunk Breakfast Run Coffee Break Afternoon Delight Checking Out Optional missions There's also a bunch of optional missions you can engage in, in case you want to score some more gear, unlockables, and cash before your Vice City trip: Check Out McKittrick Farm Collect Chemicals for Kyle Hit Avery Pawn Hit Kingpin Bowling Impounded Vehicle Pick Up a Gun Thrillbillies Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab Veteran Hunted (Jason only) Pay your room rent as quickly as possible One of your primary goals in Chapter 2 should be settling your debt with the motel manager Linda, as the more you delay paying her, the higher your checkout fee will be. If you purchased a necklace for Lucia in Chapter 1, Linda will hold it as collateral until the debt is settled, so reclaiming that sentimental piece of jewelry should be a priority. Talk to Wyman Chatting to Wyman and helping him out with his truck will also earn you an invite for a bit of off-roading fun with two of the missions: Thrillbillies and Twist, Wrist, Smash, and Grab. Find missing people While you don't have to tackle the Gellhorn’s Missing Tourist challenge as part of GTA 6's missing people questline during Chapter 2, it is recommended that you get this out of the way early. Starting this quest from Chapter 3 will be more challenging--for spoiler-specific reasons--and you can find those people of interest by checking nearby bulletin boards, posts, and notices. Play some pool Before you rob Frankie's Delights, go shoot a few rounds of pool to check off another task in your quest to be the biggest pool shark around. Grab some collectibles Several collectibles can be found in the Chapter 2 motel, so before you say goodbye to that location for good, grab 'em and sell 'em to help you reach a 100% completion rate in the game. Collectible cards Bryson Powers: On top of the washing machine in the motel laundry room Vicki: In the motel reception bathroom, on the floor underneath the toilet Victor Maravella: Check the fridge in the motel cafeteria Magazines Help Me Help You Help Me: On the motel reception desk Wizard Wang: In the motel cafeteria, next to the radio For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.

top_items.title: GTA 6’s First Patch Is Rolling Out, But Rockstar Hasn’t Said What It Does (Yet)
top_items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has gotten off to a relatively smooth start, which is rare for an open-world game of this scale. It looks like the first GTA 6 patch is also rolling out, and fortunately, it won’t be a mammoth download compared to grabbing the 211 GB game--internet service providers are probably breathing a sigh of relief right now. GTA 6 Update 01.002.002 download sizes At the time of writing, the patch hasn't been released for PS5, while Xbox Series X|S GTA 6 players can download it. The update will be necessary to continue playing the game, and it’s suspected that the PS5 version will be rolling out in stages due to the sheer number of people who own the game on that platform, over 30 million , according to market estimates from last week. PS5 – 603.8 MB Xbox Series X|S – 1.6 GB GTA 6 Update 01.002.002 patch notes That’s the million-dollar question right now, as Rockstar Games hasn’t updated its site with details on what the patch changes in the game. Given its size, this first post-launch update likely focuses on fixing bugs and addressing some of the GTA 6 error codes that have popped up, making the experience more stable. We also wouldn’t be surprised if the patch addresses exploits players have found, such as infinite cash from raiding certain drug dens in Hamlet. Once those notes are public, we’ll post them here. Just days after launch, GTA 6 is already one of the top 30 best-selling games of all time. If you’ve grabbed it and want a few tips on how crime can pay in this digital sandbox, dig into our meaty GTA 6 guides hub for plenty of walkthroughs. These cover a wide range of topics, from finding collectibles scattered throughout the game to tips on how to steal a tank and the convenience of auto-drive.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2 Is Canceled, Director Jokes, After GTA 6 Raises The Bar
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has raised the bar for open-world games, and Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzyński is feeling it. Online, the developer jokingly commented about GTA 6 setting a new gold standard for the genre, a level of quality that makes him want to pack up his Cyberpunk 2 development bags and call it a day. "GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real," Sarzyński wrote online. Probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, I mean it. Scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle. Cyberpunk 2 is canceled, Imma go sweep autumn leaves in my backyard now." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OAN_BXmVR0g Don't worry, Cyberpunk fans, because Sarzyński believes the game will offer a unique "flavor" compared to GTA 6. "Seriously though, I think we're doing something of our own, with a different, unique flavor," he wrote in a follow-up post. "GTA is impressive in a way all great art is; it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed." Meanwhile, Cyberpunk 2077 has had a great 2026, as the release of the new Cyberpunk Edgerunners anime series once again drove the game's numbers up . A meaty update also helped draw new players, and Cyberpunk 2 game director Gabe Amatangelo recently shared more thoughts on how the sequel is evolving beyond his original vision as more people join the project. Other developers across the industry have also commented on GTA 6, and Naughty Dog world design director Michael Barclay also believes that it is a technological achievement. "I've made video games for 19 years, and GTA6 appears to me as a Bugatti Veyron would to a nervous Victorian child," he wrote. items.title: Somehow, Jensen Huang Returned
items.summary: Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as president and CEO of Nvidia, while he'll also return to the Board of Directors. This is happening just hours after US President Donald Trump said Huang should come back . "The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia," the technology giant said. "In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk." Nvidia chair of the Board Harvey C. Jones said the Board believes "Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers." "We have every confidence in Jensen and look forward to working with him as he resumes his leadership of the Company. We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as Nvidia's Chief Financial Officer," he added. Trump said in a social media post that Nvidia's Board made "the correct and proper decision" to bring Huang back. Trump went on to say that the US government has no real to believe that Huang's return "poses any risk to national security." https://twitter.com/TheStalwart/status/2124868325524054057 For his part, Huang said he is honored to return to Nvidia to lead what he called "one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution." "I am also deeply thankful to our employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support. Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work.” Huang was ousted from Nvidia earlier this month after it came to light that he had a romantic relationship with a person that sources said was possibly a spy for China, though no hard evidence was ever provided to back this up. It was later reported that Huang had multiple other affairs with people he worked with. In response to the reports, Nvidia formed a committee made up of independent directors who had the job of investigating the "foreign intelligence" claims. Additionally, the committee hired an independent attorney to assist, and that investigation remains ongoing, with Huang's support. In addition to the internal investigation, there are multiple other open cases against Nvidia, including a probe by the SEC over financial accounting claims. In response to the entire situation, Nvidia has also created a new National Security and Export Control Committee to "oversee trade complicance and national security risks." Prior to today, Nvidia's board said it had no intention of bringing Huang back, but things can change fast. For his part, Huang said he would be "honored" to return as Nvidia's CEO. The Nvidia controversies led to turmoil in the stock market, in part because Nvidia is one of the “Mag 7” companies that are driving growth in the US. Some of the information coming to light suggests that Nvidia’s accounting and export control compliance are not buttoned up, and this has fueled further concerns about the growth potential and returns on investment for the AI trade. Numerous other technology and AI stocks have dropped in value significantly since the Nvidia news broke. Now that Huang is back as CEO, though, not only is Nvidia's stock price ripping, but the market overall--not just AI and tech stocks--is seeing positive upwards trends.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Approaching An Absurd New Sales Milestone, Report Says
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 's success continues to come into focus, as a new report from Alinea Analytics says the game sold 44.9 million copies through its first weekend. This would be up from the 32.5 million copies that Rockstar owner Take-Two announced last week, covering the game's pre-purchases alone. According to Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics , GTA 6 has reached 33.7 million copies sold on PS5 and 11.2 million on Xbox Series X|S, for a split of 75.1% to 24.9%. Take-Two announced $3.79 billion in sales for GTA 6 on day one , and Alinea estimated that the figure has grown to $4 billion through its first four days. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1YEHOKYVTho Sony and Microsoft keep 30% of the revenue for digital copies via platform fees, so those companies are winners here as well. Elliott went on to point out that GTA 6's $4 billion in revenue thus far is roughly equal to the combined box office results for this year's two biggest movies, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ($2.5 billion) and The Odyssey ($1.8 billion). Of course, GTA 6 is an $80-$100 game, while (hopefully) no one is spending that much to see a movie, at least not at one time. Elliott also shared data that shows around 40.8 million people logged in to play GTA 6 on Sunday, November 22, with PS5 making up 76% of those players. Additionally, Elliott said the data shows that about 20% of players--or about 9 million people--have spent more than 20 hours in the game already. GTA 6 is only going to get bigger when it comes to sales as more and more people buy the game. Additionally, GTA 6 is expected to come to PC in 2027 , which will be another selling cycle for the game. Beyond this, GTA 6 is expected to add an online mode in 2027 that will no doubt feature microtransactions and other ways for Rockstar to make money off the fanbase. For more, check out GameSpot’s GTA 6 review and our rundown of the five best things to do first. And if you’re eager for news on GTA 7 ? Get comfortable, because Rockstar is not going to announce it anytime soon .
